abilities.name: Apply marking material
abilities.function: Press a small sample of your own material onto nearby ground to see whether it leaves a visible mark; if so, draw up to three short strokes there.
abilities.costs: Study: 1 round. test: sourceId, exact id of your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated stack; x, y, a ground point at most 0.5 from you that you see now, not water, a body or a solid object; budget 0.1-1 in tenths (default 0.1) for the test and strokes; floor (default 0) must stay in the source, which needs floor + budget. One round: the probe press at load 0.5, 0.5 energy and 0.1 of the source; after a visible mark, budget - 0.1 is reserved. draw: strokes, 1-3, each 2-4 points as x, y offsets from the test point, total length at most 0.3, material 0.1-0.3 from the reserve; per stroke one round, 0.2 energy and that material, continuing each round; draw again resumes a pause. cancel: one round, no energy. Checks run before any charge; an applicator is refused (only hand contact is represented).
abilities.effects: The press records the probe load response. A sample that does not hold the load and has no flexibility pulps and releases its liquid share (its water record, else the food water composition, else its moisture property); 1/4 stays on your hand, the rest reaches the ground; solids are waste. Firm forest floor, meadow or rocky ground keeps it; a wet bank or waterlogged ground disperses it. Colour: the material colour at 0.6 opacity times coverage over the ground tone; contrast is the 0-1 colour distance, visible from 0.05. Only a visible test allows drawing, on that ground type; strokes are 0.02 wide. Deposits form a ground mark nearby people see, with geometry, amounts, colour, contrast and coverage; branching is reported only where visible strokes meet with three arms. Durability is untested: no rain, smearing or fading rule exists. A failed recheck or an unworked round pauses at no charge. The unused reserve returns at completion or cancel and drops at death. Nothing is refunded; no food, reward or comfort.

execution.progress: test and cancel take one round; draw makes one paid stroke per round. Completed strokes, the reserve and the plan persist across interruption; draw resumes after rechecks.

abilities.name: Open and separate a sample
abilities.function: Try to open one whole unit of your own enclosed material, such as a nut, by squeezing it by hand or pressing it with your own blunt tool on a rigid support; once it is open, separate its contents from the enclosure into items of their own.
abilities.costs: Study: 1 round. open: sourceId, your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated item of an enclosed material with a represented composition; quantity 1. method hand, or supported-tool with toolId (your own whole, rigid, unfractured inedible piece) and supportRef (a solid unreserved inedible object in reach, not a plant or animal, or another such own piece on firm ground where you stand). One round, 0.5 energy; the first attempt reserves one unit in a work record (workId); open with workId tries again at full cost. separate: workId of open work (or sourceId of your own opened unit); one round, 0.2 energy. cancel: one round, no energy. All need light (outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1). Checks run before any charge; a failed recheck pauses existing work at no charge.
abilities.effects: Strength is hardness / 10. A tool passes the lower of tool and support strength x (1 - flexibility), so neither is worn; a bare hand passes at most the bounded hand force of hand-break-food spread over the unit (0.1 / unit mass^(2/3)). At or below the unit strength it stays intact; above it, damage (load - strength) / strength accumulates on the unit: below 1 cracked and closed, at 1 split open. A failed attempt is a real result; repeating it changes nothing. Separation of an open unit makes a contents item and an enclosure item whose quantities are their mass shares of the unit and sum to it; the contents carry all of its food value and toxicity, whatever they are, and its origin, age and decay; the enclosure carries none. Before opening, only the exterior is seen. Cancel returns the unit to you as it now is; death leaves it where you fell. Nothing is refunded or restored; edibility, nutrition, toxins and safety stay unknown; no eating, reward or comfort.

execution.progress: Each mode takes one round and commits at its end. The work record (workId), reserved unit, damage, method and equipment persist between rounds; open or separate with the workId continues after rechecks.

developments.reason: Request: Sol asked to test physically whether a small amount of an owned berry leaves a visible colored drawing on nearby ground and, if feasible, to draw a simple branching pattern, using at most one owned berry, a reachable surface and only genuinely acquired extra materials, keeping at least three berries as food and assuming no permanence, protection or wellbeing reward. World Agent decision: develop (learning 1) a general operation to apply marking material, with an owned source stack, a reachable surface and local coordinates, a test or draw mode, a material budget, an optional acquired applicator and a bounded stroke path; the test must reuse the probe press (one round, 0.5 energy, 0.1 material) and be recorded as reuse; draw makes up to three strokes totalling at most 0.3 world units, each at most 0.2 energy, one round and 0.3 material; the reservation is atomic and never takes the source below the given floor (three of Sol's four berries); the surface lies within a 0.5 hand reach; the debit is conserved as surface deposit, hand residue and waste with no duplicated edible quantity; work persists at test and stroke boundaries, interruption stops contact, cancellation or death releases unused reservations without refunds; durability is reported as untested; rendering metadata shows only real deposits; no reward. Implemented: apply-marking-material@1 (scope long-ex20, from a reusable surfaceMarkingPackage(id, scope) factory in long-ex20-surface-marking.ts, registered last in V7_PACKAGES; one study round; the ability serializes to 3,380 code units). test checks before any charge an own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated stack, a budget of 0.1-1 in tenths, a source holding at least floor + budget, a ground point the person sees now within 0.5 of the body centre that is not water and not under a living body or a solid or reserved object, and 0.5 energy (a named applicator is refused because only hand contact is represented); it then calls the unchanged open.probe press at load 0.5 on the source, which charges its own 0.5 energy and 0.1 sample and records the load response, computes the contact transfer, opens a paid-work record (workCreate) and, only after a visible mark, reserves budget - 0.1 from the source through workAllocations and workReserve in the same atomic action; a failed transfer reserves nothing and completes the work. draw validates 1-3 strokes of 2-4 surface-local points (offsets from the test point), a total length of at most 0.3, 0.1-0.3 material each within the reserve, and every point and every 0.05 along it within reach, seen, on the tested ground type and still holding liquid; it emits a quote (stroke count, length, upper-bound energy, material and rounds), then pays one stroke per round through workPay (0.2 energy) and debits its material from the reserve, continuing each round; each stroke rechecks reach, surface, reserve, the source floor and energy, refusing with nothing spent before the first stroke and pausing at no charge afterwards; an unworked round pauses as an interruption, draw resumes the stored plan, a different plan is refused as a new attempt, and completion returns the unused reserve. cancel costs no energy and returns the unused reserve through workStop; death drops it at the body once; applied marks remain and nothing is refunded. Work, reserve and modes are owner-only: others cannot draw, cancel, eat or test with Sol's stacks. Effects and events: a non-solid, unreserved applied-mark object on the ground, created by the person and seen by nearby people through ordinary observation, with surface-local stroke geometry, deposit, colour, contrast, coverage, creation time and dated changes; the work record keeps the full debit split; events marking-tested, marking-draw-quoted, marking-stroke, marking-paused, marking-resumed, marking-interrupted, marking-completed, marking-cancelled and marking-ended (plus the probe's trial-result and trial-material-consumed and workPay's process-progress) carry actor, mode, source, reserve, surface reference, location, tick, measured outcome and view metadata with visible deposited portions only; verified personal records (openRemember) hold the observed test result and the drawn pattern with the ground and durability untested; branching is reported only where visible strokes meet with at least three arms. The viewer gains an applied-mark drawing that shows only visible deposits at their recorded colour, width and geometry and nothing for a failed or invisible transfer, and the forest canvas omits the generic shadow for this kind; existing drawings are unchanged. Modeling assumptions: (1) a sample pulps when the probe press does not hold (strength = hardness / 10 below the load 0.5) and its flexibility is 0, so berries pulp and hard or flexible materials release no liquid; (2) the liquid share is the stack's own water record, else the food water composition (berry 0.85, root 0.75), else the resource moisture property; (3) a quarter of the released liquid stays on the hand as residue and the rest reaches the ground, solids are waste, and an unpulped sample is wholly waste as the probe already consumes it; (4) firm forest floor, meadow or rocky ground with waterlogging at most 0.1 holds the liquid, a wet bank or waterlogged ground disperses it as waste, and water cells are not ground; (5) the liquid carries the material's represented colour (berry #b34f66), applied at opacity 0.6 times coverage over a ground tone taken from the observatory terrain palette (forest floor #52644a, meadow #7d8860, rocky #888b78, wet bank #596e61) because no other ground appearance is represented; contrast is the Euclidean RGB distance over its maximum, visible from 0.05, giving Sol's berry on forest floor #8c575b at contrast 0.14; (6) coverage = min(1, deposited mass / (area x 0.05)) with the resource mass per unit, a 0.02-radius test spot and 0.02-wide strokes; (7) visibility follows the world's light-independent perception; (8) no rain, smearing or fading rule exists, so the mark stays as applied and every record states durability untested and wetness not modelled after application; (9) unused reserved berries remain ordinary food under the world's tenths accounting. Conservation in Sol's case: the test debits 0.1 (deposit 0.06375, residue 0.02125, waste 0.015) and each 0.3 stroke deposits 0.19125, so a test plus three strokes costs four rounds, 1.1 energy and exactly one berry unit while the source stays at three; this was confirmed on the archived round-8 world with item-2-sol-16. Reuse: the unchanged open.probe press handler (recorded as reuse, not a new invention), openRemember, openConditions and openMaterial, the collective-work escrow and paid-work helpers, the food water composition, collectiveFoodProfile and the tenths accounting; the expression mark and name signs (no physical effect), the ex16 branch-screen (an appearance-valued structure without a deposit) and the ex13 residue-transfer packages (non-food residue without colour) were checked and are not equivalent, and no earlier package deposits colour. No practice milestone (the practice evidence is the unqualified completion event), satisfaction source, reward, nutrition, protection or comfort is added. First release: no; the specification is self-consistent and implementable as a simplified but real mechanism, the missing facts (pigment colour, ground colour, transfer share and durability) are covered by the recorded assumptions, and the applicator parameter is refused rather than simulated.

Request: Lin asked for a physically feasible way to open one of two freshly gathered owned hazelnuts (item-11-lin-113) and inspect its contents, keeping any usable kernel separately, without eating it, without assuming tools and without inferring nutrition, toxicity, safety or preparation needs. World Agent decision: develop (learning 1) a general operation open-and-separate-sample(sourceId, quantity, method, toolId?, supportRef?, workId?) for owned discrete enclosed materials, with hand compression and supported tool compression sharing one work and separation mechanism; an opening attempt costs one round and 0.5 energy and reserves one specimen, and a separation round after a real opening costs 0.2 energy; enclosure strength, safe hand force, composition and recoverability must come from implemented material definitions, implemented here when missing, and an unknown response must not default to easy opening or a free kernel; after fracture all material is accounted for as enclosure, recovered contents, attached contents, fragments and residue summing to the input, with fractional accounting, no new nutrition and no decay reset; work record, pause, resume by workId, cancellation and death as specified; only observed appearance is recorded; no eating, safety certificate or reward. Implemented: open-and-separate-sample@1 (scope long-ex20, from a sampleOpeningPackage(id, scope, compositions) factory in long-ex20-sample-opening.ts, registered last in V7_PACKAGES; one study round; the ability serializes to 3,183 code units; sourceId, toolId and supportRef are exact-visible references; no drawing is added, view metadata travels on events and the viewer is unchanged). Modes and costs: open (sourceId, quantity 1, method hand or supported-tool) checks before any charge a living person, an own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated whole unit of a material with a represented composition (hazelnut only), light (the ex19 rule, daylight or indoor light above 0.1) and 0.5 energy, and for supported-tool an own whole, rigid (hardness at least 1), unfractured inedible tool (the ex19 piece and contact checks) and a support that is either a solid, unreserved, visible object in reach of a represented inedible material with hardness at least 1 that is not a plant or an animal, or another such own piece on firm ordinary ground where the person stands; it then opens a work record (workCreate), reserves exactly one unit (workAllocations, workReserve) and pays one round (workPay); open with workId is a new explicit attempt at full cost; separate (workId of opened work, or sourceId of an own opened unit returned by cancel) pays one round and 0.2 energy; cancel takes one round and no energy. Effects: the ex17/ex19 law, load = the weaker surface's strength x (1 - flexibility) with strength = hardness / 10, adds damage (load - strength) / strength only when the load exceeds the unit's strength and keeps it on the unit (processing enclosureOpening): cracked and closed below 1, split open at 1; tools and supports carry no more than their own strength and are not worn; separation replaces the opened unit with an own hazelnut-kernel item of 0.4 and an own hazelnut-shell item of 0.6, both carrying the unit's origin, harvest tick and decay; the ledger records input 1 (mass 0.2), enclosure 0.6, recovered 0.4, attached 0, fragments 0 and residue 0, summing to the input in quantity and mass; the other hazelnut stays an ordinary unit. Events: sample-opening-started, -attempted, -fractured, -opened, -separated, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled and -failed (plus workPay's process-progress, workStop's process-stopped and openRemember's trial-result and information-confirmed), each emitted only at its transition and carrying the work summary and view metadata (operation, workId, source, specimen, stage, method, contact pose, tool and support, enclosure shape, size, colour, texture, fracture state and crack, exposed contents only once open, products and residue only after separation, never a badge); verified personal records hold the observed response per material, method and surfaces and the observed contents with their visibility limits; no strength, load or composition value appears in agent-visible text before it is observed. Lifecycle: every stage commits atomically at the end of its round; a failed recheck of existing work (light, energy, tool or support) records a pause at no charge and the next paid round emits resumed; cancel returns the reserved unit to its owner as it now is (untouched, cracked or opened, never restored) and a later open or separate continues from its recorded damage; death stops the work and leaves the unit where the person fell, neither restored nor separated; a reserved unit that spoils ends the work; nothing is refunded; there is no passive processing or recurring drain. Modeling assumptions: (1) no grip or compression hand force existed on the strength scale, so a bare hand applies hand-break-food@1's bounded bare-hand force (0.1 on its size-scaled scale strength x mass^(2/3)) spread over the unit, a load of 0.1 / mass^(2/3), about 0.29 for a 0.2-mass hazelnut against its strength 0.4, so a bare hand can neither open nor crack a hazelnut and repeated squeezes change nothing; (2) supported compression transmits the weaker of tool and support as in ex17/ex19, without a separate limit on the person's force; (3) crushing of contents is not represented: a controlled compression stops when the enclosure gives; (4) the hazelnut composition is kernel 0.4 and shell 0.6 by mass, the lower bound of commonly reported kernel percentages of about 40-50 %, exact in tenths; (5) a split shell releases its whole kernel by hand (the kernel lies loose in the cavity and its skin counts as kernel), so attached contents, fragments and residue are 0; (6) one unit of either part is one whole unit's mass, so the kernel row has 45 nutrition and 0 toxicity per unit (all of the unit's nutrition and toxicity divided by its share; 0.4 x 45 = 18), eats like a hazelnut (ingredient hazelnut, method unprocessed, quality 0.8, the default meal quality, so no meal variety is gained) and keeps the hazelnut's other properties and decay lifetime, while the shell row has no nutrition or toxicity, keeps the unit's hardness, flexibility, fuel and moisture and, like the world's other inedible materials, does not decay; (7) separated parts age at the ordinary rate, since no faster rate for an exposed kernel is validated; (8) appearance reuses the ex13 hazelnut exterior model (ovoid, 0.035 wide, about 0.05 long, fine ridges) and the ex13 interior colour #d8bd91 and texture, with contents scaled by the cube root of their share, as drawing metadata only; (9) light is required for every paid stage as in ex19. Fractional behaviour in this world: eat, give, drop and pickup take whole units only (integer quantity of at least 1) and a resource reference over several items is refused as ambiguous, so a 0.4 kernel or 0.6 shell item can be neither eaten, handed over nor dropped, and could not be picked up again after a death drop; ordinary decay continues on the kernel; no split creates nutrition (three separated hazelnuts carry exactly 54 in 1.2 kernel units). Lin's case, checked on the archived round-12 world: after one study round a bare-hand squeeze reserved one unit of item-11-lin-113, cost 0.5 energy and left it intact with no crack, separation was refused because only the exterior is visible, a repeat cost another 0.5 with no new finding, and cancel returned the untouched unit; Lin holds no tool, so supported compression is refused before any charge until Lin acquires a blunt tool such as a gathered stone and stands at a rigid support such as a stone outcrop, where one stone press opens a hazelnut. Reuse: ex19 shell-compression-opening@1's law and the shared long-ex19-material-contact helpers (light, firm ground, own piece, contact read on a copy, whole unit) imported unchanged (the ex19 factory was not extended, because its separate refusal and ability text would have to change); ex17 mechanical-food-handling@1's transmission law; foundation-open@1 open.probe's press rule (a material holds a load not above its strength) and object reach rule, without invoking the probe or charging its 0.5 energy and 0.1 sample; ex16 hand-break-food@1's HAND_FORCE; the ex13 exterior and opening appearance models; and the helpers underlying apply-marking-material@1 as in ex20 source revision 2 (openMaterial, openConditions, openRemember, tenths accounting, collectiveFoodProfile and the collective-work escrow and paid-work helpers); ex12 food inspection (a 0.1 portion's exposure fraction) and the ex13 hazelnut packages (bound to specific items, no conserved partition) represent no shell and kernel and were not reused for composition. ex19's five packages and apply-marking-material@1 are byte-identical. No practice milestone (the practice evidence is the unqualified separation event), satisfaction source, pleasure, comfort, nutrition or energy reward is added; the optional 0.1 short-lived pleasure was not added because no installed package uses an ordinary non-protected experience event for informative results. First release: no; the specification is self-consistent and is implemented as a simplified but real mechanism with real costs, state changes and events, and the missing definitions (hand force, composition, recoverability) are implemented and tested here.
